content:
marco: Heads up - I ran into a CI flake when running the ruby sampleapp smoke tests in GH Actions. The bundler step sometimes fails with native gem compile errors on older runners.

priya: Which gem? We pin nokogiri and some native deps in the template.

marco: It's rack-protection native extension in one of the transitive deps (surprising). Error log says missing libssl headers on ubuntu-18.04 image.

devrel: We intentionally use ubuntu-latest in the template which maps to 22.04 typically. But some runners still use older images in matrix. We should make the CI tolerable.

oliver: Short term: add explicit setup for openssl-dev via apt before bundling and set RUBYOPT to avoid native ext compilation where possible. Longer term: pin GH runner images in the workflow or use actions/setup-ruby with ruby-builder.

marco: I pushed a tiny workflow tweak in sampleapp repo: install libssl-dev, build-essential, and set BUNDLE_FORCE_RUBY_PLATFORM=true to avoid native extensions where possible.

priya: Can you add a note to sampleapp README "CI: known flaky on older runners, see .github/workflows" and reference the PR? New contributors keep opening issues.

marco: Will do. Also added a small script to run smoke locally with docker to reproduce the environment.

devrel: Nice. Please make the change backward-compatible for contributors using macOS dev machines.

oliver: Review LGTM, merge when green. devex-bot: link to 0.6.3-maintenance milestone.
